messages:
ana: Quick follow-up from the all-hands security segment. Post short questions here.

sarah: SOC2 Type 2 status: evidence ingestion underway, target end of Q3.

pranav: ISO 27001 planned after SOC2 Type 2; no firm date yet.

lucy: Can Private customers push audit logs to their SIEM now?

pranav: Yes. Private supports syslog/Kinesis into customer VPC; Hosted/Dedicated have S3 export. Docs draft incoming.

sarah: KMS/BYOK: we support customer rotation with a 24h migration window; runbook coming.

lucy: Retention tiers?

pranav: Hosted 90d, Dedicated up to 365d, Private customer-managed (3+ years possible).

ops-bot: Created SECURITY-4321 for runbook + docs + sales one-pager.

ana: ana: Please produce a one-page bullets summary for sales by Monday.

pranav: Will post runbook and one-pager links here when ready.
